roadmap.title: Prologue and Route A first half
roadmap.description: Play the opening on Normal or Easy and chain a 100-hit combo against the Giant Shade. Kill 100 sheep in the Northern Plains before the story time jump. Clear side quests, fish, and level up the fishing line while the first half is open.

roadmap.title: Route A second half
roadmap.description: After the time jump, play Route A2 and take the timed boss attempts at the Lost Shrine, Wrecked Ship, Façade, Junk Heap and Aerie. Save before each fight and reload as needed. Grow the Moonflowers with a clock advance and finish the fishing chain.

roadmap.title: Shadowlord's Castle and Ending A
roadmap.description: Finish Route A with the castle bosses on a separate save, kill the Shadowlord, and enter the character name for Ending A.

roadmap.title: Route B and the Mother's Diary
roadmap.description: Load the Ending A save, finish Route B for Ending B, and clear the Mother's Diary mode to complete the weapon collection.

roadmap.title: Route C and D
roadmap.description: Replay the second half for Ending C, then make two saves at the Lost Shrine roof and use the second one for the berserk Kainé timed fight and Ending D.

roadmap.title: Route E
roadmap.description: Start a new save, reach the end of the Hook fight, then play as Kainé for Daredevil and Ending E, which restores the original save.

roadmap.title: Cleanup grinds and speedrun
roadmap.description: Upgrade weapons, reach 1,000,000 Gold, then finish the speedrun to unlock the final achievement.

achievements.description: Congratulations! Thank you for playing!
achievements.summary: Unlock every other achievement, then leave the clear data screen of a completed run.

steps.text: Unlock the other 46 achievements first, then finish the last run and leave its clear data screen.

achievements.description: Grimoire Weiss joined your party.
achievements.summary: Free Grimoire Weiss so he joins the party.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Lost Shrine} roof, enter the altar, free the book and ask @npc{Grimoire Weiss} to help rescue Yonah.

achievements.description: Kainé joined your party.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Hook} in the @loc{Aerie} with Kainé and defeat it. She joins afterwards.

achievements.description: Emil joined your party.

steps.text: Start Route A2, then visit Emil at his mansion after the five-year time jump. He joins you there.

achievements.description: You freed Kainé from her petrification.

steps.text: After Emil gains his power, go to the @loc{Library} and free Kainé.
Defeat @enemy{Jack of Hearts} in the basement, then talk to Devola and Popola. The achievement unlocks when you wake up at home.

achievements.description: You gave Louise's letter to the Postman.
achievements.summary: Give Louise's letter to the Postman.

guide.context: This only happens in Route C. In Route B, Kainé tears the letter up.

steps.text: In Route C, defeat @enemy{Louise} on the @loc{Wrecked Ship} and leave Seafront.
Watch Kainé meet the Postman on the beach and hand him the letter.

achievements.description: You completed the key to the Shadowlord's castle.
achievements.summary: Complete the key to the Shadowlord's castle by collecting all five Mysterious Stone Fragments.

steps.text: Collect one Fragment from each of these places, in any order: the @loc{Aerie}, @loc{Façade}, the @loc{Forest of Myth}, the @loc{Junk Heap} and the @loc{Lost Shrine}.
Enter the @loc{Northern Plains} after the fifth Fragment. The achievement unlocks there.

achievements.description: You defeated the Shadowlord.

steps.text: Reach the end of Route A2 in the @loc{Shadowlord's Castle} and land the final blow on the @enemy{Shadowlord}.

achievements.description: You pulled off a 50-hit combo.

guide.context: The combo resets after about 3-4 seconds without hitting an enemy.

steps.text: Fight the Shades in the Prologue and keep hitting them without pause until the counter reaches 50.

achievements.description: You pulled off a 100-hit combo.

guide.context: Magic does not count toward the combo. If you miss the Prologue, any large fight later also works, or you can start a new game.

steps.text: In the Prologue, defeat the small Shades first, then hit the @enemy{Giant Shade} until its timer appears.
Keep hitting the Giant Shade without striking its head, so it stays alive and regains a little health. Dodge its attacks and reach 100 hits.

achievements.description: You learned every type of magic.

steps.text: Finish the mission at @loc{Emil's Mansion} in Route A1. The achievement unlocks when it ends, so it cannot be missed.

achievements.description: You collected 50 percent of all words.

steps.text: Defeat Shades throughout the game. Different Shade types drop different words.
Equip each new word so the count keeps rising. About 50 percent comes from normal play.

achievements.description: You found every weapon.

guide.context: The four free YoRHa DLC weapons and Kainé's Sword do not count. No weapon can be lost for good, and anything missing can be collected during Route B.

collectibles.name: Labyrinth's Whisper

collectibles.name: Fool's Lament

collectibles.name: Fool's Accord

achievements.description: You completed 10 quests.

guide.context: Repeating a repeatable quest does not add to the count.

steps.text: Start side quests in the Village after the Lost Shrine. Good early ones are Book Smarts, Herbal Remedies, Boar Hunt and The Lost Eggs.
Finish quests until your quest log shows 10 completed.

achievements.description: You completed 20 quests.

guide.context: Repeating a repeatable quest does not add to the count.

steps.text: Keep clearing side quests in the Village and Seafront, such as the Fisherman's Gambit chain and Fragile Delivery 2, until 20 are complete.

achievements.description: You completed 30 quests.

guide.context: More than 60 side quests exist.

steps.text: Keep finishing quests. Ask Devola in the Village Tavern for the ones you have not taken yet.
Turn in Fragile Delivery 3 or any other quest that brings the total to 30.

achievements.description: You completed the Recycled World Quest.

steps.text: After Ending A, load the Ending A save and search the ground floor of your home for Mother's Diary.
Clear all three levels behind each of the three doors. You cannot save inside, so a death restarts that door.
The last two levels are one Barren Temple level and one level on the Barren Temple bridgeway. Beat both to complete the mode.

achievements.description: You accumulated 1,000,000 pieces of gold.

guide.context: The Gold is not cumulative. You only need it in your inventory once.

steps.text: Keep your materials and fish instead of selling them during the game.
At the end, sell all materials and fish until your Gold reaches 1,000,000.

achievements.description: You read all novel segments about your friends' pasts.
achievements.summary: Read all three story text segments about your friends' pasts.

steps.text: In Route B, read Kainé's Dreams and Emil's Memory.
In Route C, defeat Devola and Popola in the castle and read Emil's Memories. The achievement unlocks after the third.

achievements.description: You viewed the first Ending (Ending A).

guide.context: Enter the exact name you gave your character.

steps.text: Beat Route A and answer Yonah's question about her favourite person by typing your character's name exactly.
Leave the save screen after the credits.

achievements.description: You viewed the second Ending (Ending B).

steps.text: Load the Ending A save and play Route B through the Shadowlord fight.
Make a new save and leave the clear data screen.

achievements.description: You viewed the third Ending (Ending C).

guide.context: You need all 33 base-game weapons to reach Ending C.

steps.text: In Route C, reach the end and choose "End Kainé's life & free her from her burden".
Save into a new slot and leave the save screen. Keep your Lost Shrine roof saves for Ending D.

achievements.description: You viewed the fourth Ending (Ending D).

guide.context: Making this choice deletes your saves until you finish Ending E.

steps.text: Reload your second Lost Shrine roof save and beat the castle bosses again.
At Tyrann's offer, pick the option to sacrifice yourself so Kainé becomes human. Confirm every prompt, then type your character's name.

achievements.description: You viewed the final Ending (Ending E).

guide.context: This ending happens on a new save made after Ending D.

steps.text: Start a new game with a different name and play to the end of the Hook fight.
Play as Kainé through the story.
In the @loc{Copied City}, choose "recover the person you cherish" and enter your first character's name to restore your old save.
Watch the credits.

achievements.description: You successfully cultivated the Legendary Flower.
achievements.summary: Grow a White Moonflower in your garden.

guide.context: The garden uses real time. Flowers wither after two days, so advance your PC clock. Save to a separate slot first.

steps.text: Complete both florist quests (the Tulip Bulb errand and the Bounty Fertilizer errand) to unlock the garden. Buy Gold, Red and Blue Moonflower Seeds from the Seafront florist.
Plant Gold and Red in alternating rows, move the PC clock forward two days and harvest. Keep at least 10 Peach seeds.
Plant Gold and Blue the same way for Indigo seeds. Then plant Indigo and Red for Pink seeds.
Plant Pink and Peach in alternating rows. White seeds appear rarely, so repeat until you get one.

achievements.description: You caught a Rhizodont.

guide.context: You need the top fishing level, from finishing the Fisherman's Gambit quests.

steps.text: Finish the Fisherman's Gambit quests with the old man on the Seafront pier.
Go to the quicksand lake in the southwest @loc{Desert}, bait with Sardines and catch a Rhizodont.

achievements.description: You caught one of every type of Fish.

guide.context: Bought fish do not count. Finishing the Fisherman's Gambit quests from the old man on the Seafront pier raise your fishing level so you can catch the harder fish.

achievements.description: You collected 50 types of raw Materials.

steps.text: Loot harvest points, crates and enemy drops as you play. Normal play usually reaches 50 types.

achievements.description: You upgraded 5/38 Weapons to their maximum level.
achievements.summary: Upgrade 5 weapons to their maximum level.

guide.context: Maximum level is level 4.

steps.text: Unlock Two Brothers' Weaponry in the @loc{Junk Heap} with the story quest there.
Gather materials and upgrade 5 weapons to level 4 at the shop.

achievements.description: You upgraded 15/38 Weapons to their maximum level.
achievements.summary: Upgrade 15 weapons to their maximum level.

guide.context: Maximum level is level 4.

steps.text: Keep upgrading weapons at Two Brothers' Weaponry until 15 have reached level 4.

achievements.description: You upgraded 33/38 Weapons to their maximum level.
achievements.summary: Upgrade 33 weapons to their maximum level.

guide.context: Maximum level is level 4. Kainé's Sword from Ending E and the four free YoRHa weapons count, so you can skip hard ones. Keep your materials until the end.

steps.text: Collect Kainé's Sword outside the Aerie after Ending E, and install the free YoRHa DLC for four more weapons.
Farm the rarest materials first. Good places are the Diary's third-door crate room, the Junk Heap lower floors, and the Fortune Teller's repeatable dream.
Upgrade weapons at Two Brothers' Weaponry until 33 are at level 4.

achievements.description: You rode a Boar for at least 5:00 minutes in one sitting.
achievements.summary: Ride a Boar for 5 minutes in one sitting.

guide.context: Being knocked off the Boar restarts the timer.

steps.text: Finish the quest Boar Hunt to learn to ride Boars.
Mount a Boar in the Southern Plains and stay on it for 5 minutes. Standing still works well.

achievements.description: You killed 100 Sheep.

guide.context: Sheep only spawn in Route A1. After the time jump their numbers drop sharply, so finish this in Route A1.

steps.text: In the Northern Plains, kill all the sheep, then leave to the Village and return so they respawn.
Repeat about five times until you reach 100 kills.

achievements.description: You completed the game within 15 hours.

guide.context: Pausing and menus do not stop the clock, so save at a mailbox and quit before a break. Only Ending A needs to be reached.

steps.text: Start a new game on Easy and skip all cutscenes and side quests.
Sell your materials to buy the Phoenix Spear in Route A2.
In the Forest of Myth rescue only the Mayor, with the answers Secret, Sunlight and Man.
Reach Ending A in under 15 hours.

achievements.description: You defeated Gretel within three minutes and twenty seconds.

guide.context: This fight is timed and cutscenes count. It repeats in Routes A, B and C/D, so you get several tries. Route C/D is your last chance before a new game.

steps.text: Save at the mailbox before entering the altar. Play the first try normally, then reload and skip cutscenes.
Use Strength Drops. Attack Gretel until the shield appears, then stand in the sunbeam in the room center and kill the Shades that spawn.
The achievement unlocks when you regain control in the Kainé fight.

achievements.description: You stopped the berserk Kainé within one minute.
achievements.summary: Stop the berserk Kainé within 1 minute.

guide.context: This fight is timed and cutscenes count. It repeats in Routes A, B and C/D, so you get several tries. Route C/D is your last chance before a new game.

steps.text: Fight her right after Gretel.
When she climbs the walls, knock her down with @mechanic{Dark Lance}, then attack her on the ground and break the seal.

achievements.description: You defeated P-33 within four and a half minutes.

guide.context: This fight is timed and cutscenes count. It repeats in Routes A, B and C/D, so you get several tries. Route C/D is your last chance before a new game.

steps.text: Save at the Junk Heap mailbox before the boss.
In phase one, back off when it electrifies the floor and use Magic. In phase two, use Magic on the winged form, dodge the debris and defeat the small Shade.

achievements.description: You defeated Wendy within eight and a half minutes.

guide.context: This fight is timed and cutscenes count. It repeats in Routes A, B and C/D, so you get several tries. Route C/D is your last chance before a new game. Make a new save for the second try and keep your first save.

steps.text: Save at the Aerie mailbox before the fight.
Use Magic Capsules. Break Wendy down to one third and defeat her Shades.
Run to the upper platform and cast Magic from behind. For the last third, jump down to the first large platform near the mailbox.

achievements.description: You defeated Roc within three and a half minutes.
achievements.summary: Defeat Roc in the Desert Wolf den within 3 minutes 30 seconds.

guide.context: This fight is timed and cutscenes count. It repeats in Routes A, B and C/D, so you get several tries. Route C/D is your last chance before a new game.

steps.text: Fight Roc in the Wolf den in the Desert. The earlier Façade fight does not count.
Kill the Wolves quickly until Roc comes down, then attack him until the King lands the final blow.

achievements.description: You defeated Louise within 5:00 minutes.

guide.context: This fight is timed and cutscenes count. It repeats in Routes A, B and C/D, so you get several tries. Route C/D is your last chance before a new game.

steps.text: Save at the mailbox below the Wrecked Ship deck before the fight.
Use Strength or Magic Drops on the floating heads. After the jump to the beach, keep attacking until the final Dark Lance cutscene.

achievements.description: You drove off Devola and Popola within three minutes.
achievements.summary: Drive off Devola and Popola within 3 minutes.

guide.context: This fight is timed and cutscenes count. It repeats in Routes A, B and C/D, so you get several tries. Route C/D is your last chance before a new game. You cannot save inside the castle, so the second try needs a fresh reload from before the castle.

steps.text: Use Strength Drops. Chase the twins around the room, since they teleport.
Lower them to 6/10 health for the first scene, then to 1/10 health. The achievement unlocks after the last cutscene.

achievements.description: You defeated Goose within two minutes.
achievements.summary: Defeat Goose in its first form within 2 minutes.

guide.context: This fight is timed and cutscenes count. It repeats in Routes A, B and C/D, so you get several tries. Route C/D is your last chance before a new game.

steps.text: Defeat the Shade waves in the ballroom until Goose appears.
Only the first, unarmored Goose counts; the armored one that follows does not.

achievements.description: You defeated Devola and Popola within three and a half minutes.
achievements.summary: Defeat Devola and Popola within 3 minutes 30 seconds.

guide.context: This fight is timed and cutscenes count. It repeats in Routes A, B and C/D, so you get several tries. Route C/D is your last chance before a new game.

steps.text: Defeat Devola first. Popola then goes berserk.
Wait out her opening dialogue, then finish her. The achievement unlocks when you regain control.

achievements.description: You defeated Grimoire Noir within one and a half minutes.
achievements.summary: Defeat Grimoire Noir within 1 minute 30 seconds.

guide.context: This fight is timed and cutscenes count. It repeats in Routes A, B and C/D, so you get several tries. Route C/D is your last chance before a new game.

steps.text: In the last castle area, use melee to break his shield and keep attacking. Strength Capsules help.

achievements.description: You defeated the Shadowlord within four minutes and twenty seconds.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Shadowlord within 4 minutes 20 seconds.

guide.context: This fight is timed and cutscenes count. It repeats in Routes A, B and C/D, so you get several tries. Route C/D is your last chance before a new game.

steps.text: Fight him right after Grimoire Weiss's scene.
Wait out each long cutscene when needed. In the final phase, sprint to him and strike three times.
The achievement unlocks when you regain control after the final cutscene.

achievements.description: You defeated the berserk Kainé within three and a half minutes.
achievements.summary: Defeat the berserk Kainé in the Route C/D fight after the Shadowlord within 3 minutes 30 seconds.

guide.context: This fight only appears in Route C/D, and it is your only chance. Do not unlock Ending D without it.

steps.text: Make two separate saves at the Lost Shrine roof mailbox. Use the first for Ending C.
After Ending C, reload the second save and play through the castle bosses again, skipping cutscenes.
Break Kainé's shield while dodging the magic orbs. In the second phase use only melee. The achievement unlocks before the final choice.

achievements.description: You risked life & limb 10 times to discover someone's secret.
achievements.summary: Look under Kainé's skirt 10 times while playing as her in Route E.

guide.context: Do this before finishing Route E. Once Route E ends, its save is gone.

steps.text: When you control Kainé in Route E, move the camera down under her nightgown. She kicks the camera away each time.
Wait until she sheathes her weapon, then repeat until you have done it 10 times.
